premise: After first wing deviation + repair, every sixth move exposes a deviation-invariant vertical two-piece P0 residual with lower support distance 0 and upper support distance 1.
rejectedCandidate: If defender does not preempt the lower cell, P0 may always take it and force the upper response.
discoveryMethodBoundary: Finite concrete branches were used only to falsify the candidate theorem. They are not proof premises for any promoted CPCX rule.
exactRepairRule: Opponent singleton obligations are classified before CPCX progress.
Exactly one opponent singleton forces its unique block.
Two or more distinct opponent singletons are exact one-slot overload.
Only after deterministic forced-singleton closure returns OPEN may a multi-piece progress primitive fire.

observedRepair.note: One symmetric control also induces a subsequent forced P1 response; this is handled by the same deterministic closure rather than a special case.

authorityEffect: NONE. Prototype research falsifier and rule-order correction only.
